autopaterns.performance.title: Performance mode
autopaterns.performance.state.pending: Original settings are waiting to be restored
autopaterns.performance.state.ready: Ready · applied when a recording or playback starts
autopaterns.performance.state.off: Disabled · only the inactivity frame limit is lifted
autopaterns.performance.enabled.tip: During a recording / playback: reduced settings, start after 2 s. Everything is restored when it stops.
autopaterns.performance.busy: Change the performance mode when nothing is running.
autopaterns.performance.profile.balanced: Turns off clouds, entity shadows, vignette, fade; fewer particles; distance ≤ 10; high priority.
autopaterns.performance.profile.performa: Balanced + minimal particles, smooth lighting, transparency, biome blend, entities 50 %%; distance ≤ 8; shaders off.
Full 2.x performance mode: 10 graphics settings, distance ≤ 6, shaders and resource packs off, high priority.
autopaterns.performance.always: Always (even when disabled): the inactivity frame limit is lifted during an action.
autopaterns.performance.nextTime: Changes will apply to the next action.
autopaterns.performance.opt.inactivity.t: Lifts the frame limit when the game is idle or minimised.
autopaterns.performance.opt.renderDistan: Lowered to the chosen value (never raised).
autopaterns.performance.opt.simulationDi: Singleplayer only. Beware: entities and redstone stop beyond it.
autopaterns.performance.opt.preset.tip: “Fast” preset; every option it touches is restored exactly.
autopaterns.performance.opt.biomeBlend.t: Biome colour blend radius set to 0.
autopaterns.performance.opt.mipmaps.tip: Mipmap levels set to 0 (reloads textures at start and end).
autopaterns.performance.opt.fpsMax.tip: Frame limit lowered to the chosen value (never raised).
autopaterns.performance.opt.packs.tip: Removes personal resource packs (resourcepacks folder) then reloads resources.
autopaterns.performance.opt.shaders.tip: Turns off Iris shaders if installed; original state saved.
autopaterns.performance.opt.priority.tip: Game process at high priority during the action.
autopaterns.performance.detail.backupFai: settings could not be backed up, nothing was changed
autopaterns.performance.problem.backup: Original settings could not be saved: performance mode not applied.
autopaterns.performance.problem.restore: Not restored: %s (retried at next launch or with “Restore now”)
autopaterns.performance.restore.tip: Immediately puts the original graphics settings back.
autopaterns.performance.restore.partial: Partial restore: some settings are still pending (see status).
autopaterns.performance.restore.failed: Performance mode: %1$s setting(s) not restored (%2$s). See the log.
autopaterns.performance.recovered: §eOriginal graphics settings restored (the game closed during a playback).
autopaterns.performance.background.tip: Frame limit when the window is not focused (60 → 30 → 120 → unlimited).
autopaterns.performance.results.never: No activation since the game started.
autopaterns.performance.result.notSaved: original value not saved, left unchanged
